data.desc: Founded in 1998 as an energy conservation consultancy, Energys Group has since transitioned into a vertically integrated energy efficiency and decarbonisation solutions provider for the built environment. Serving organisations from both the private and public sectors, including schools, universities, hospitals and offices primarily in the UK, the Company's vision is to deliver innovative solutions that reduce carbon emissions, lower costs and support the Net Zero agenda - alongside improving the wellbeing of building users within the built environment.
